title: NodeList
description: Response shape of GET /api/admin/nodes (docs/024 §5.1). One row per registered backend process; ordered by last_seen DESC so live nodes float to the top. The UI uses seconds_since to render the heartbeat-freshness dot (≤90s green / ≤600s amber / else red per docs/024 §1.2).

nodes.description: Zero or more registered nodes. Empty array is a valid response on a fresh deployment.

node_type.description: Platform classification — matches the CHECK on eidan.node_heartbeats.node_type.

status.description: Stored row state. UI may treat as offline when seconds_since exceeds a freshness threshold regardless of the stored value (docs/024 §3 — stop() does not mark offline).

last_seen.description: Timestamp of the last heartbeat UPSERT.

seconds_since.description: Server-computed (now() - last_seen) in seconds so the UI does not need to negotiate clock skew.

metadata.description: Platform fingerprint — always carries hostname / platform / python; per-platform keys (fly_app, fly_region, …) layer on top.

plugins.description: Plugins active on this node when the heartbeat was last written (issue #52). Per-process — the Pi and a Fly machine can carry different sets after a runtime install. Empty array on nodes whose process predates the schema bump.

served_kinds.description: Job kinds this node is built to serve from the eidan.jobs delegation queue, with per-kind capacity (issue #249). Advertised by the node's plugins at activation. Empty array on nodes that serve no queued kinds, or whose process predates the schema bump.

name.description: Plugin manifest name — the on-disk directory name under plugins/.

version.description: Plugin manifest version string (semver-ish; the host does not validate the shape here).

tier.description: Which bundle the plugin ships in. Mirrors plugin.yaml's tier field.

kind.description: A job kind this node serves from eidan.jobs (e.g. 'code').

capacity.description: How many jobs of this kind the node runs concurrently — its per-kind in-flight cap.
